# CM24: extended formal carriers preserve the strict source and B_N=0

Driver-ID: EM-DVR-FBF223 / CONTROL_PLANE
Date: 2026-10-13 UTC
Status: new auxiliary linear-algebra direction; fixed CM24 endpoint goal OPEN.
Original CM24 and HART owners are unchanged. This is a Root direction note,
with directed NONBLIND paper review by a local UNKNOWN helper, not a new
Task, Claim, Run, owner or branch.

## Fixed inputs and exact domain

Work over F_p with p=6m+1 prime, m>=2, N=3m and q=x(x-3)^2/4. Keep the
original C, tau, F_CM, beta components, literal g, rho leading16, complete
2m<r<=N tail, and class-19 +t0 epsilon_N term. The source map is

    (MF)_n=-[x^(N+n)]q'(x)F(q(x)), 1<=n<N.

We enlarge the FORMAL polynomial degree bound from degree<N to degree<=p-2.
There is no identification modulo z^p-z, source projection, or change to the
original fixed degree<N construction. One original boundary condition,
B_N=0, can be retained in the enlarged construction.

Dependencies are the full Source proofs at:
- 2afa093dfd43de5d86b63b3b940b40034ea3b0e3: cubic source annihilators;
- d0274b66f3b4622519cd2dda659ce13415baff51: old-image completeness and fixed right inverse;
- 4176498bac854ace8fbfd8d1bb397294921524d3: actual half-source obstruction.

The local directed reviews separately pin their complete input files. No
mathematical script, old p13 sample, prime census, Green solve or experimental
producer/checker was run for this direction.

## Coefficient obstruction extends to arbitrary formal degree

For 1<=s<=m-1 define

    Gamma_s(y)=sum_(k=0)^(2s) binom(2s,k)(-3)^(2s-k)y_(N-s-k).

For every finite formal F=sum_j f_j z^j, the first directed review proves

    Gamma_s(MF)=-9*4^(s-1) f_(p-s-1).

It proves the formula directly from the coefficient window and a binomial
identity dividing only by a nonzero ell<p. Terms of degree>=p-1 are outside
every strict-source coefficient window. No functional-polynomial reduction
is used.

For m>=3, Lambda=Gamma_2-4Gamma_1 therefore gives

    Lambda(MF)=36(f_(p-2)-f_(p-3)).

The already proved actual half source v=-beta^h-t has
Lambda(v)=19816/3465!=0. Consequently any formal source lift MF=v requires
degree F>=p-3. This strengthens the old degree<N exclusion to degree<=p-4;
it does not assert sufficiency at degree p-3. Lambda is not applied at m=2.

## Preset completion of the strict-source image

The old image I=M(P_degree<N) equals the joint kernel of all Gamma_s and
has rank 2m. Fix H_s=z^(p-s-1). Their Gamma matrix is diagonal:

    Gamma_t(MH_s)=-9*4^(t-1) delta_(t,s).

For any independently specified strict source y choose

    c_s=-Gamma_s(y)/(9*4^(s-1)),
    y_0=y-sum_s c_s MH_s,
    F=R_old(y_0)+sum_s c_s H_s.

Then MF=y and degree F<=p-2. R_old is the already preset old-image right
inverse. The fixed basis and linear response use the prescribed source;
they are not selected to fit a desired endpoint.

## Gauss resonances: one compatibility and its source-preserving repair

For the unchanged operator D*=z(1-z)d^2+(3/2-5z/2)d-5/9 write

    F_j=A_j B_(j+1)-D_j B_j,
    A_j=(j+1)(j+3/2), D_j=(j+2/3)(j+5/6).

In 0<=j<=p-2, D_j vanishes exactly at 4m and 5m; A_j vanishes at
N-1=3m-1. Set B_(p-1)=0. Descending above 5m determines B_(5m+1).
The genuine top compatibility is F_(5m)=A_(5m)B_(5m+1). After that
B_(5m) is free. Rows 5m-1 down to 4m+1 transfer it with a nonzero
coefficient to B_(4m+1), so it can satisfy the row at 4m. Thus the
two resonant rows are not independent forcing obstructions.

The fixed polynomial

    K=z^(5m)-R_old(M z^(5m))

has MK=0, K_(5m)=1 and no coefficient above 5m: every Gamma_s(Mz^(5m))
vanishes, and R_old returns degree<N. For any F choose

    lambda=A_(5m) B_(5m+1)-F_(5m), F'=F+lambda K.

The upper block is unchanged, MF'=MF, and the top compatibility holds.
Choose the remaining free B_(5m) to satisfy the row at 4m.

## The original B_N=0 can also be retained

B_(4m) is still free. For every row j=N,...,4m-1, both A_j and D_j are
units: the A zero N-1 lies below this interval and the D zeros 4m,5m
lie above it. Descending these rows makes

    B_N = alpha B_(4m)+eta,
    alpha=product_(j=N)^(4m-1) A_j/D_j != 0.

Choose B_(4m)=-eta/alpha. This sets B_N=0. The next row j=N-1 has
A_(N-1)=0 and D_(N-1)!=0, so it determines the lower coefficient and
does not impose a new condition on B_N. The remaining lower rows descend
using D_j units. All equations remain satisfied and the source is unchanged.

Therefore

    M composed with D* : {B: degree B<=p-2, B_N=0} -> F_p^(N-1)

is surjective. This statement is restricted to the enlarged formal carrier
space. It does not assert an original degree<N carrier for the actual source.

## Paid construction and remaining mathematical work

A conservative implementation may store the full truncated source matrix
and the fixed old-image inverse. Constructing columns via the fixed cubic
recurrence costs O(p^2) field operations; dense old-image factorization is
O(p^3) field operations with O(p) inversions and O(p^2) field-element
storage. Applying the resulting fixed source response costs O(p^2) field
operations, followed by O(p) descending rows, including paid divisions and
the two scalar choices. Input, output, retained joint state, setup and
field/bit arithmetic all remain charged. These are upper bounds for the
explicit auxiliary construction, not a total bit-cost or performance gain.

The next mathematical action is to derive the enlarged carrier's complete
flat-gauge boundary and seed ledger and compare its resulting endpoint with

prove that endpoint equality. The full half-prefix tail, lower-block
transport and class-19 top correction remain explicit dependencies. No
mother-goal completion, Native acceptance or physical/Foundation promotion

# CM24 formal-degree extension: directed paper review

Verdict: PASS for the proposed coefficient formula, Lambda degree obstruction,
and strict-source surjectivity. The Gauss resonance locations are correct, but
the two rows are not two independent forcing obstructions. In the enlarged
formal-polynomial space an explicit source-preserving adjustment resolves them.
This remains only auxiliary source algebra; the fixed CM24 endpoint target is
OPEN.

Reviewer provenance: UNKNOWN local Root-delegated nonauthor helper
`/root/cm24_extension_paper_check`; directed NONBLIND. No borrowed actor/activity,
new owner, Task, Claim, Run, branch, Native acceptance or Source write. Root
retains direction; original Hart and CM24 ownership are unchanged. Review was
paper only: three complete proof files were read, and file bytes/hashes were
measured for custody. No mathematical script, prime check, census, Green solve,
old p13 computation or sample was executed.

## 1. Objects, index support and arbitrary formal degree

Use the exact input p=6m+1, m>=2, N=3m, q=x(x-3)^2/4, and

    (MF)_n=-[x^(N+n)]q'(x)F(q(x)), 1<=n<N,
    Gamma_s(y)=sum_{k=0}^{2s} binom(2s,k)(-3)^(2s-k)y_(N-s-k),
    L_s=p-s-1, 1<=s<=m-1.

The coefficient window in Gamma is L_s-2s=2N-3s through L_s=2N-s;
it lies wholly between N+1 and 2N-1. Thus for every finite formal polynomial
F=sum_j f_j z^j, without reducing polynomial functions modulo z^p-z,

    Gamma_s(MF)=-[x^L_s](x-3)^(2s)q'(x)F(q(x)).

For j<L_s set ell=L_s-j, 1<=ell<=p-1, and a=2j+2s+1. The monomial
coefficient, before its nonzero scalar factor 3/4^(j+1), is

    (-3)^(a-ell) [-3 binom(a,ell-1)-binom(a,ell)].

The integer relation ell*binom(a,ell)=(a-ell+1)binom(a,ell-1), reduced
in F_p, gives a-ell+1=-3ell because a+2ell+1=2p. Hence it is zero.
This remains valid for a>=p or out-of-support binomials; only ell is divided
by, and it is a unit. Any displayed negative power of -3 is a field-unit
power, not a claim of negative polynomial support.

For j>L_s the factor q^j has minimum x-degree j, so the coefficient is zero.
For j=L_s the constant factors give

    (-3)^(2s) (9/4)^(j+1)
      =9^s (9/4)^(p-s)=9*4^(s-1).

Fermat's identity is legal for the nonzero field element 9/4. Therefore

    Gamma_s(MF)=-9*4^(s-1) f_(p-s-1).                         (A)

All signs and units in the proposed formula pass. In fact coefficients
f_j with j>=p-1 never reach any strict-source row, whose maximum exponent
is p-2. Thus degree<=p-2 already realizes the unrestricted formal M image.
This is not a quotient identifying formal polynomials as field functions.

## 2. Lambda and the exact degree scope

For m>=3 both Gamma_1 and Gamma_2 exist, and (A) gives

    Lambda(MF)=(Gamma_2-4Gamma_1)(MF)
              =36(f_(p-2)-f_(p-3)).                          (B)

The already Source-proved actual source satisfies

    Lambda(v)=19816/3465 != 0,
    v=-beta^h-t,

for the stated prime family with m>=3. This review uses that complete input
proof, including its nonvanishing argument, as a dependency; it does not
repeat its checks. Equation (B) excludes every F of degree<=p-4 and requires
degree F>=p-3 if MF=v. It does not establish that degree p-3 suffices.

For m=2 (p=13), Gamma_2 is unavailable. No Lambda conclusion is applied
there. The previous degree<N boundary certificate retains its exact scope
and is not rerun. These are source/lift restrictions, not a no-go for the
fixed scalar F_CM, other beta components, or other repair mechanisms.

## 3. Preset high monomials give the full strict-source image

Let I=M(P_degree<N), whose already proved rank is 2m and whose image is
ker Gamma_1 intersect ... intersect ker Gamma_(m-1). For the preset monomials

    H_s=z^(p-s-1), 1<=s<=m-1,

(A) gives the diagonal matrix

    Gamma_t(MH_s)=-9*4^(t-1) delta_(t,s).

Every diagonal is a unit. Therefore for an arbitrary source y choose

    c_s=-Gamma_s(y)/(9*4^(s-1)),
    y_0=y-sum_s c_s MH_s.

Then all Gamma_t(y_0)=0, so the already fixed old-image right inverse gives
F_0 of degree<N with MF_0=y_0. The polynomial

    F=F_0+sum_s c_s H_s, degree F<=p-2,

satisfies MF=y. Equivalently these m-1 new columns complement the old
2m-dimensional image in its full (3m-1)-dimensional strict-source space.
No dependence on a desired endpoint or fitted seed enters the preset basis.
Applying a right inverse to y is ordinary prescribed linear response; it is
not itself the missing independent CM24 endpoint mechanism.

## 4. Gauss carrier resonances and a source-preserving repair

For the exact D*=z(1-z)d^2+(3/2-5z/2)d-5/9, the polynomial rows are

    F_j=A_j B_(j+1)-D_j B_j,
    A_j=(j+1)(j+3/2), D_j=(j+2/3)(j+5/6).

In the finite range 0<=j<=p-2, D_j vanishes exactly at j=4m and 5m;
A_j vanishes exactly at j=N-1=3m-1. Its next zero j=p-1 is outside
this range. In particular A_(4m)=(4m+1)(m+1) and
A_(5m)=(5m+1)(2m+1) are units. These are finite integer positions,
not reductions identifying different polynomial degrees.

Take degree B<=p-2 and B_(p-1)=0. Descending through j>5m determines
B_(5m+1). At j=5m one needs the genuine top compatibility

    F_(5m)=A_(5m) B_(5m+1),                                  (C)

and B_(5m) remains free. Descending from j=5m-1 through 4m+1 makes
B_(4m+1) an affine function of this free B_(5m), with nonzero linear
coefficient product_{j=4m+1}^{5m-1} A_j/D_j. Thus the j=4m equation
can always be met by choosing B_(5m); B_(4m) is then free. Below that,
all D_j are units; the zero A_(N-1) simply disconnects a lower block and
causes no division. Hence there is one top forcing compatibility, not two
independent obstructions for arbitrary F in degree<=p-2.

Moreover even (C) can be repaired without changing MF. The polynomial
z^(5m) has all Gamma_s(M z^(5m)) zero, because every L_s>=5m+1.
By old-image completeness let R be its fixed old-image right inverse and put

    K=z^(5m)-R(M z^(5m)).

Then MK=0, K_(5m)=1, and K has no coefficients above 5m. For any
F of degree<=p-2, compute the unchanged upper descending block and choose

    lambda=A_(5m) B_(5m+1)-F_(5m),
    F'=F+lambda K.

This preserves MF'=MF and satisfies (C). The remaining resonance is solved
as above. Thus, as an auxiliary finite linear-algebra statement,

    M composed with D* : P_degree<=p-2 -> F_p^(N-1)

is surjective. It uses only already proved completeness and unit descending
rows, with every source adjustment specified by a fixed linear operator.
No new computation is required. The old condition B_N=0 is NOT silently
retained for these enlarged carriers; imposing it or other fixed endpoint
constraints is a separate problem. The fixed degree<N carrier and its
original forcing are untouched.

## 5. Limits and custody

This proves neither an extended flat-gauge endpoint theorem nor equality
with the fixed CM24 scalar target. New carrier boundary rows, seeds, full
half-prefix tail, lower-block transport, original C/tau/F_CM, beta^1/beta^q,
literal g, original rho leading16, and class-19 +t0 epsilon_N must all stay
in their actual ledger. No source projection or kernel adjustment erases
those data. An independent mechanism and its complete endpoint connection
remain open, even though the auxiliary Gauss compatibility can be handled.

Source references supplied by Root: Gamma proof 2afa093dfd43de5d86b63b3b940b40034ea3b0e3;
universal half-source proof 4176498bac854ace8fbfd8d1bb397294921524d3;
image completeness d0274b66f3b4622519cd2dda659ce13415baff51.
This helper read the three full local exact files and pins their measured
bytes/SHA-256; it performed no separate remote Source readback. These are
classical finite-field auxiliary observer statements with paid construction,
field arithmetic, input/output and retained joint source state, not a native
spatial dimension, physical/Working Truth/Foundation promotion or free-cost
claim. Review time and provenance are separate metadata.

# Extended CM24 Gauss carrier with B_N=0: paper addendum

Verdict: PASS. The surjectivity from the preceding directed paper review
continues to hold after imposing the single coefficient condition B_N=0:

    M composed with D* :
      {B in F_p[z]: degree B<=p-2 and B_N=0} -> F_p^(N-1)

is surjective for the same declared finite prime family. The degree<N
condition has been relaxed. No fixed CM24 endpoint equality follows.

unchanged. This is a continuation of the same paper review, not a new owner,
Task, Claim, Run, branch, Source write or decisive Native acceptance. No
mathematical script, prime check, sample, Green solve or old check was run.

uses its exact source-image, kernel adjustment and descending-row results.

## 1. Exact remaining degree of freedom

Keep p=6m+1, m>=2, N=3m, and the exact row equation

    F'_j=A_j B_(j+1)-D_j B_j,
    A_j=(j+1)(j+3/2), D_j=(j+2/3)(j+5/6).

For a chosen strict source y, the preceding review constructs F' of
degree<=p-2 with MF'=y. Its K adjustment satisfies the j=5m compatibility;
the free B_(5m) then satisfies the j=4m row. That row contains no B_(4m),
because D_(4m)=0. Consequently B_(4m) is still a genuinely free field
coefficient at this stage. Choosing it does not disturb any already solved
row j>=4m or alter F', hence cannot alter MF'.

## 2. Unit transport to the prescribed zero coefficient

For each actual integer j in the complete range

    N=3m <= j <= 4m-1,

both A_j and D_j are units. In the full range 0<=j<=p-2 the zeros of D
are 4m and 5m, both above this interval; the only zero of A is N-1,
immediately below it. The next A zero p-1 is outside the complete carrier
range. No resonance is crossed and no empty or inverted index range occurs
for m>=2.

Descending these rows gives an affine expression

    B_N=alpha B_(4m)+beta,
    alpha=product_{j=N}^{4m-1} A_j/D_j != 0,

where beta is fixed by the already prescribed coefficients F'_N through
F'_(4m-1). Thus the preset response rule

    B_(4m)=-beta/alpha

sets B_N=0 uniquely. It uses only field units and the independently given
forcing, rather than a desired endpoint, tau or F_CM value. The row j=N
is included; stopping at N+1 would not prove the requested coefficient
condition.

## 3. The lower and upper boundary rows remain consistent

The next row j=N-1 has A_(N-1)=0 and D_(N-1) nonzero, so it simply sets

    B_(N-1)=-F'_(N-1)/D_(N-1).

It imposes no further condition on B_N. Every D_j below it is also a unit,
so all remaining rows down to j=0 have an ordinary descending solution.
At the top, B_(p-1)=0 is unchanged, and all constructed coefficients above
p-2 are zero; D*B therefore has no unaccounted coefficient beyond the
declared degree. The choices at 5m, 4m and N thus satisfy the entire finite
polynomial equation D*B=F', not merely a central subset of its rows.

For every y the resulting B belongs to the stated constrained space and
satisfies M(D*B)=MF'=y. This proves the restricted surjectivity.

## 4. What has and has not been recovered

The literal old coefficient condition B_N=0 can therefore be retained in
the enlarged carrier space. It is not equivalent to restoring degree<N:
coefficients B_(N+1),...,B_(p-2) may be present, and their full signed
contributions cannot be discarded. The original uniquely prescribed
degree<N carrier and original forcing are not modified by this auxiliary
existence theorem.

transport theorem for that enlargement or equality with the fixed CM24
target. All original C/tau/F_CM and beta components, lower and upper blocks,

and the normalized endpoint vector are determined. The seed scalar is fixed
by the strict source, not freely adjustable. A separate outside-block scalar
is necessary for the carrier endpoint B(1). The fixed C/tau/F_CM target and

and uses the already proved review chain as exact dependencies.

## 1. Actual enlarged objects and the full gauge equation

Work over the declared F_p, p=6m+1 prime in classes13/19mod24, m>=2,
N=3m=(p-1)/2. Keep original rho leading16, C, tau, F_CM, all beta
components and the complete original half-prefix tail unchanged. Here

    q=x(x-3)^2/4,
    D*=z(1-z)d^2+(3/2-5z/2)d-5/9,
    degree B<=p-2, B_N=0, F'=D*B,
    W_B=x^(-N)(x-3)B(q)/24, P_B=Pi_(0..N) W_B.

This is an enlarged formal carrier, not the original degree<N carrier.
Its coefficients above N are retained, even though its coefficient at N
is zero. The finite Laurent projection is the same actual central cut.

For completeness the full gauge equation does extend to every finite B.
Let a=2x(x-1)(x-4), b=5x^2-15x+4, w=x^(-N)(x-3)/24. Since -N=1/2
as a field scalar, formal differentiation at the actual Laurent exponents
gives

    w'=x^(-N)(x-1)/(16x),
    w''=x^(-N)(x+1)/(32x^2),
    q'=3(x-3)(x-1)/4, q''=3(x-2)/2,
    q(1-q)=-x(x-3)^2(x-1)^2(x-4)/16.

The three chain-rule coefficients, by finite polynomial expansion, are

    a w(q')^2 = -x^(-N)q' q(1-q),
    a(2w'q'+wq'')+b wq' = -x^(-N)q'(3/2-5q/2),
    a w''+b w'+(x-1)w = (5/9)x^(-N)q'.

Thus J W_B=-x^(-N)q'F'(q) for arbitrary finite B. No formal exponent is
reduced or identified with another exponent. The already reviewed universal
projection identity Pi J=J Pi therefore gives the actual central equation

    J P_B=S,
    S_n=-[x^(N+n)]q'F'(q), 0<=n<=N.                      (1)

Because degree F'<=p-2, the already reviewed legal primitive argument gives
S_N=0. This is raw forcing before zero-seed normalization, not deletion of
a normalized class-dependent terminal term.

## 2. Generic seed and every finite forcing row

Consume the frozen fundamentals

    phi_n=4^(-n)h_n/g, h_0=h_N=g (unit), J phi=0,
    psi_0=0, psi_1=1, J psi=4 epsilon_0-4 epsilon_N.

The origin row of J phi gives phi_0=1 and phi_1=1/4. Preserve the actual
new carrier's P_0 and P_1 and define

    A=P_0,
    c=4P_1-P_0=S_0,
    gamma=P_1-P_0/4=c/4.

The generic normalized response is precisely

    Z=P_B-A phi-(c/4)psi.                                  (2)

It has Z_0=Z_1=0. Its complete finite forcing, with y_n=S_n for 1<=n<N,
is

    J Z=S-c epsilon_0+c epsilon_N
       =(0,y_1,...,y_(N-1),c).                            (3)

No old t_0/4 coefficient is assigned to the new B. That special coefficient
is recovered only if this carrier's actual c is separately proved to equal
t_0. Neither B_N=0 nor raw S_N=0 proves such equality.

## 3. The scalar c is uniquely fixed by the complete strict source

Let a_k=(2k+1)(k+1), b_k=-(10k^2+5k+1), and d_k=4k(2k-1) be the
monomial coefficients of J. Its finite row n is

    (J P)_n=a_(n-1)P_(n-1)+b_n P_n+d_(n+1)P_(n+1).

The fixed submatrix with rows0,...,N-1 and columns1,...,N is lower
triangular with diagonal d_(n+1)=4(n+1)(2n+1), all units. Consequently
rank J>=N. Its nonzero phi kernel gives rank J<=N, so rank J=N.

The vector h_n=4^n g phi_n is a left kernel. Indeed, for each column k,
the left-kernel expression, divided only by the unit 4^k g, is

    4a_k phi_(k+1)+b_k phi_k+(d_k/4)phi_(k-1)
      =d_(k+1)phi_(k+1)+b_k phi_k+a_(k-1)phi_(k-1)=0.

The boundary columns use a_N=d_0=0. This does not divide any internal
h coefficient. The left kernel is one-dimensional and h_0=g is nonzero.
Apply it to the complete raw source (c,y,0) in (1):

    g c+sum_(n=1)^(N-1) h_n y_n=0,
    c=-sum_(n=1)^(N-1) h_n y_n/g.                         (4)

Thus c must be retained or reconstructed for the complete boundary ledger,
but it is not an extra independent source coordinate once all y is kept.
No source-preserving adjustment of F' or B can freely change c. A compressed
source observer may discard it only if its declared future language and
paid reconstruction still preserve this signed weighted sum.

## 4. Exact normalized endpoint vector

Because 4^N=1 and h_N=g, phi_N=1. Its homogeneous top row gives
phi_(N-1)=1. Let eta denote the actual canonical value psi_N; eta is a
fixed basis value, not a selectable parameter. The top row of J psi gives
psi_(N-1)=eta-4. The top row of J P_B equals S_N=0, hence

    E=P_N=P_(N-1).

Equation (2) therefore gives the complete adjacent endpoint vector

    Z_N     =E-A-c eta/4,
    Z_(N-1)=E-A-c eta/4+c.                               (5)

Its signed terminal difference is Z_(N-1)-Z_N=c, exactly (3).
No assertion of a free E or A is needed for this result.

The already frozen Green formula supplies a useful equivalent ledger,
without any new solve or execution. Define

    Q_psi(y)=sum_(j=1)^(N-1) 4^(j-1)psi_j y_j.

Using G(N,j)=4^(j-1)(phi_j eta-psi_j) and (4), the unique zero-seed
response has

    Z_N=-c eta/4-Q_psi(y),
    E-A=-Q_psi(y).                                      (6)

Thus normalized endpoints are fixed weighted functionals of the complete
strict source and the retained canonical basis, not additional freely
chosen boundary data. Computing these sums and the basis has paid costs.

Keep the frozen old half-prefix source t with t_N=0 and
t_0=(chi_3-1)/6. Its own normalization has terminal t_0, including the
actual class-19 value -1/3. For the actual missing strict source

    v_n=-beta^h_n-t_n,
    c_h=sum_(n=1)^(N-1) h_n beta^h_n/g,

equation (4) yields

    c_v=c_h-t_0.                                       (7)

The terminal of the old normalized response plus the new correction is
t_0+c_v=c_h, which is precisely the canonical terminal of the actual
zero-seed half response. This is linear source-response bookkeeping; it
does not provide the independent fixed-target endpoint mechanism.

If an additional proposed mechanism requires correction terminal zero,
the exact remaining weighted-compatibility obligation is

    sum h_n v_n=0, equivalently c_h=t_0.                 (8)

More generally a prescribed correction terminal b requires
sum h_n v_n=-g b. Such equalities cannot be achieved by changing a
source-preserving carrier. Neither (8) nor an identification of c_h with
an old class-dependent terminal is proved here. The original class-19
term is explicitly present rather than silently copied or canceled.

## 6. The full carrier endpoint needs a different scalar observer

The normalized central endpoint in (5) is different from B(1), the carrier
endpoint appearing in the original constructor comparison. Central data
alone cannot recover B(1), even with degree<=p-2 and B_N=0. The exact
countervariation delta B=1 satisfies all these carrier constraints and

    delta W=x^(-N)(x-3)/24,
    Pi delta W=0,

since its only exponents are -N and1-N, both negative. It changes B(1)
by1 while preserving every P_n, raw/normalized source, seed and central

not a countervariation of the original singleton frozen forcing.

For a precise endpoint-only observer retain the full finite outer blocks

    W_-=sum_(k<0)[x^k]W_B x^k,
    W_+=sum_(k>N)[x^k]W_B x^k,
    Omega_B=W_-(1)+W_+(1).

Because q(1)=1 and W_B(1)=-B(1)/12, the complete endpoint identity is

    B(1)=-12(P_B(1)+Omega_B).                            (9)

Thus one extra scalar Omega_B is sufficient for the future language
consisting only of B(1) and its fixed scalar multiples, given the complete
central P_B. The countervariation proves that an observer distinguishing
this outside endpoint contribution is necessary on the enlarged ambient
family. Omega is not freely assigned from a desired target; it is the

The actual raw seed A is still retained: normalization alone does not

## 2. Interface A: finite Laurent projection certificate

Input:

Output:

* The four crossing witnesses below, with actual integer indices.
* Optionally the complete retained coefficient vector of J Pi P. This is

The monomial law is

    J x^k=a_k x^(k+1)+b_k x^k+d_k x^(k-1),

    outside -> inside: a_(-1)=0; d_(N+1)=4(N+1)(2N+1)=0,

These are all possible crossings because exponent shifts are only -1,0,+1.

## 3. Interface B: strict source and prescribed terminal compatibility

Input:

* The fixed canonical h/g descriptor, including g unit.

  actual raw seed. Normalized Z alone is not this input.

      Omega_B=W_-(1)+W_+(1),

The necessity is for retaining information distinguishing this endpoint

## 5. State, joint retention and paid costs

Retained mathematical state binds the parameter/operator/basis descriptor
to complete signed source y, actual raw central P, derived c, any independent
b and its residual, and the actual Omega/outer-object binding. Canonical
phi/psi/h data stay linked to the same p and finite indices. c and Omega
are different objects: c is fixed by y, while Omega retains carrier-endpoint
information absent from central P. Original Source proofs, B coefficients,
outer blocks, full half-prefix tail, class branch and all target components
remain preserved; this proposal does not authorize deleting evidence.

Operational endpoint compression to Omega is permitted only within the
explicit B(1)/fixed-multiple future language. It must not be reused for
different endpoints, derivative jets, full coefficient recovery, expanded
source operations or a changed cut. Those require the original full state
or additional proved observers. Normalizing Z does not authorize dropping

Let ell be the number of supplied Laurent coefficients and b_p=ceil(log2 p).
The following are paid field-operation bounds, not measurements:

* A's four scalar crossing checks cost O(1). Materializing J Pi P from an
  already linked central view costs O(N) field operations and O(N) retained

  or Omega from unprocessed B is additional paid construction; this contract

  pays for every supplied outer coefficient.

Keeping full joint central/source/basis views takes O(N) field elements,
or O(N b_p) bits, plus immutable evidence/bindings and actual supplied
outer state. Each readout can use O(1) accumulator workspace after inputs
are available; that does not erase the retained input evidence. A stored

With multiplication cost M(b_p), O(N) field arithmetic contributes

## 6. Failure modes, reporting and unsupported claims

* WRONG_DOMAIN: mismatched p/N/operator/cut, nonfinite Laurent data, wrong

* PRECONDITION_UNVERIFIED: prime-family/g-unit/basis provenance missing,

* INCOMPATIBLE_TERMINAL: kappa(y,b) is nonzero for a legal independently

* INSUFFICIENT_ENDPOINT_STATE: central P is supplied without an actual

* UNSUPPORTED_FUTURE_LANGUAGE: another cut, infinite/rational expansion,
